name: wiwihaun-skills
description: Two skills for Claude Code: a free local YouTube-to-Traditional-Chinese transcript pipeline, and a pre-build gate that pressure-tests a product idea before any code gets written.

plugins.name: yt2script
plugins.description: YouTube link to verbatim Traditional Chinese transcript. Human subtitles first, native auto-captions second, local Whisper large-v3 third. No API keys, no paid services, nothing leaves the machine except the audio fetch.

plugins.name: prebuild-gate
plugins.description: Gate a product idea before writing code: how it charges, and where the first paying customers come from. Researches what comparable products actually earn in the last 30 days and returns a go / no-go memo.
